title: How many more horses can the thief steal before the king notices?
description: Kavya sets out horses in the square stable and the video finds the fewest horses that still show five on every side.
teaching_notes: One idea: the real number of horses is twenty take away the corner horses, and a stable has four corners. Watch for children who think the thief can steal until the stable is empty.

source: King's Horses, how many more can be stolen
video_script.why: The child must find where the pattern of corner horses stops, which needs all four corners to be used.
video_script.substitution: Write each number of horses next to the corner horses it needs, and stop when more than four corners are needed.
video_script.anchor: Kavya setting out counters for horses on a square stable drawn on the floor
video_script.wrong_answer: the thief can steal horses until none are left
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu thinks any number of horses can be arranged with five on a side, so the thief can keep stealing.

final_answer.value: 2 more horses, down to 16; with 15 the king would find 5 on a side is no longer possible
final_answer.spoken: two more horses, down to sixteen, because fifteen horses would need five corner horses and a stable has only four corners

never_show: the number sixteen as the fewest horses, before the idea part
maths_rules: counted total with 5 on each of 4 sides is 20; real horses = 20 - corner horses
16 horses: 20 - 16 = 4 corner horses, all four corners used
15 horses: 20 - 15 = 5 corner horses needed, but a stable has only 4 corners, so it fails
fewest horses is 16; from 18 the thief can steal 18 - 16 = 2 more
slip: the thief can steal until none are left, which is false
video_script.design: One idea: corner horses needed = 20 take away the horses, and at most 4 are possible. Wrong idea: any number of horses works. The stable from above stays on the stage and a small table fills on the working board.

<bookmark mark='pay'/>Sixteen is the fewest, and eighteen take away sixteen means the thief can steal two more horses.
